rows.note: Use 生產 as the all-purpose term for the industrial process or activity of producing goods, including goods currently being produced.

example.english: This factory mainly handles production of parts.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 cong2 zyu2 jiu3 sang1 caan2 ling4 gin6

rows.note: Use 產量 when production means the total quantity or output produced.

example.english: This year's production is higher than last year's.
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 ge3 caan2 loeng6 bei2 soeng6 nin4 gou1

rows.note: Use 演出 for a theatrical production viewed as the presentation or performance of a play.

example.english: The production of this stage play was excellent.
example.traditional: 呢套舞台劇嘅演出好精彩。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 mou5 toi4 kek6 ge3 jin2 ceot1 hou2 zing1 coi2

rows.note: Use 大龍鳳 when someone turns a simple matter into an elaborate fuss or spectacle.

example.english: You don't need to make such a production out of setting a table.
example.traditional: 你唔使為咗擺張枱搞咁大龍鳳。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 wai6 zo2 baai2 zoeng1 toi2 gaau2 gam3 daai6 lung4 fung6
